hero.title: Work where it matters.

benefits.title: Your benefits at KSK Farmos GmbH & Co. KG

items.title: Above-tariff payment
items.text: We pay significantly above the tariff — because your work is worth a lot to us.

items.title: Strong team
items.text: Friendly atmosphere, mutual support, and genuine appreciation.

items.title: Training & Further Education
items.text: Regular training and further education opportunities through institutes with certificate issuance — fully funded by the company.

items.title: Flexibility
items.text: We take your private and professional life into consideration and design our scheduling flexibly.

items.title: Meaningful work
items.text: You make a real difference in the lives of seriously ill people every day.

items.title: Career opportunities
items.text: Advancement opportunities and support for personal development. Your performance and commitment can lead to new career opportunities with us.

steps.title: Submit Your Application
steps.text: Via our form, email, or by phone.

steps.title: Personal Interview
steps.text: We'd love to meet you — relaxed and on equal footing.

steps.title: Welcome to the Team
steps.text: Thorough onboarding, training, and ongoing support.

closing.title: Ready for the Next Step?
closing.text: Apply now — it's quick and straightforward.
